name: Urijah
bio: Urijah son of Shemaiah of Kiriath-jearim prophesied against Jerusalem in the same era as Jeremiah. King Jehoiakim sought to kill him for it; Urijah fled to Egypt, but Jehoiakim sent Elnathan son of Achbor to retrieve him, and had him executed and his body thrown into a common grave (Jeremiah 26:20-23). He is a different figure from Uriah the Hittite or Uriah the priest under Ahaz.
